profile.description:
HappyHorse 1.1, from Alibaba, supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video from up to nine images, all with synchronized native audio. It has sharper visual quality, smoother motion, and stronger character consistency across clips, at 720p or 1080p for 3 to 15 seconds.

Modes (auto-detected)
- Text-to-Video: send a prompt only.
- Image-to-Video: attach one image to animate it. The output follows the image's aspect ratio.
- Reference-to-Video: attach 2 to 9 reference images and name them in your prompt as character1, character2, and so on for consistent subjects, scenes, and styles.

Input limits
- Prompt up to 2,500 characters.
- Images: JPEG, PNG, BMP, or WEBP. One image for image-to-video, up to nine for reference-to-video.
- No video or audio input.

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.
